_readme: One-off + annual seasonal events with predictable timing that iCal / scraping doesn't cover well. Loaded by scripts.seasonal at pipeline run time and merged into events.json. Each entry either has 'date' (one specific date) or 'window' (start-end date range). Regenerate by hand each year — annuals bump when Em confirms the year's dates. Anything more automated needs a per-venue scraper, which is what Phase 2 is doing everywhere else.

events.name: Butler's Orchard Pumpkin Patch
events.description: Hayrides, pumpkin picking in the field, kids play area with slides + bounce pillow + farm animals. Buy tickets ahead online for weekend visits.

events.name: Boo at the Zoo
events.description: After-hours family Halloween event. Trick-or-treat stations along the zoo path, animal encounters, entertainment. Sells out — book tickets in advance.

events.name: ZooLights
events.description: Half-million LED light display through the zoo. Live music, ice sculptures, seasonal treats. Closed some nights — check schedule.

events.name: Downtown Rockville Hometown Holidays
events.description: Tree lighting, live music, kids' crafts, hot cocoa, visit from Santa. Annual — confirm date and time each November on rockvillemd.gov.

events.name: Bethesda Row Winter Wonderland
events.description: Twinkling lights across Bethesda Row, ice-skating rink some years, weekend visits from Santa. Confirm exact dates each November.

events.name: Cherry Blossom Festival — Family Day
events.description: Family Day during the National Cherry Blossom Festival — Japanese cultural performances, hands-on crafts, storytelling. Annual — confirm exact date in February.

events.name: Butler's Orchard Strawberry Season
events.cost_label: By the pound; call for current pricing
events.description: U-pick strawberries in the fields. Check the farm's Pick-Your-Own line before driving out — season can end fast in a warm spring.
